text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm at the cafeteria to get some food,
when...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Woo! That is spicy! Water! I need some water!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Stop! You are hilarious! I'm dead! Beyond dead! I'm a zombie!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Can't you tell? We're trying out the new
thing on
the menu.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
This fiery hot flavor is wild! No choice
but to ride
it out!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But my mouth is, like, literally on fire! I can't take it anymore. I give up...
Muahaha! Exactly as I predicted! I win!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch! I thought she'd put up a little more
of a
fight...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's this about a fight?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A bet! A wager! A game of chance with

Nakayama! We bet on whether you'd be
able to
finish that spicy treat you've got
there!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You gave up, so I won! Here's a little
token of my
gratitude. I call this dance
"Thanks So Much For
Quitting,
Jordan"! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey, excuse yooouu?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... I take it back. I'm still in this! I'll
eat every
last bite, just you watch!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
This time I'm for real! I'll ride out this
heat wave
to the bitter end!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
For real?! It's so hot though! But you're
hotter
right now! No cap, you are fire,
queen!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
What's happening? Are Jordan and her
friends
doing something funny again?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's say it together!
Hey,
Jordan...

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Show us what you got!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Show us what ya got.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, you! Who asked you to butt in?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha! A sudden reversal... How can I not
get in on
this?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gimme a break! Not so fast, everyone. I
bet her
mouth can't take any more. It's
not like she can
keep going just because
you cheered for—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Chomp... Munch... Gulp! Ack, that's hot!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're actually doing it?! Easily
influenced much?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate me! There's no
cheer or
trend I can't get behind!

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text: Eat! Eat! Eat! ♪ Show us what you got! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Egged on by the crowd, Tosen Jordan
wolfs down
mouthful after mouthful of
the spicy snack. But
just as she's about
to reach her last bite...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So... hot... Ugh! I can't feel my lips!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But... like... as if I'm gonna lose!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But... like... as if I'm gonna lose!
choice_data_list: I wanna see some guts, Jordan!
Drink water with all your might!
Drink water with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right... I got thiiis!
choice_data_list: I wanna see some guts, Jordan!
Drink water with all your might!
Drink water with all your might!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Woo! Housed it! I win! In your face!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
And by the way... Pfft! Like, what even
was that
cheer you gave at the end? You
were getting way
too into it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Eh, whatever. I guess it gave me the
energy to
wolf it down!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yass, Jordan! Let's get a victory selfie!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sure! Get over here! You too! Hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I need to get a shot of Golshi's
gloomy face
too!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait... Where'd she go?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
She went home. Said she was gonna
watch some
"creamy rakshasa meal"
video or something.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What the hell is that about? I'm the one whose mouth is on fire!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Urgh, what's her deal?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right... Gulp... Gulp... Pheeew!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Cough... Washed it all down!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nice, Jordan! That was seriously lit!
Everyone's
losing it!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! I guess might makes right, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
But whatever! I won! Right, Golshi! It's
my win,
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Curse you! Curse yooou! I've gotta hand
it to you
though. That was pretty
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I got a good shot of you sweating like
crazy and
slopping down water!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! There's no way I look good!
Delete that!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Also, I put a clam and a lobster on either
side of
you. I did a bang-up job with the
touch-ups, so
feel free to make it your
new background! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: As if I'd want that!
